_comment: Single source of truth for homepage events. Times are ISO 8601 with the WIB offset (+07:00). An event moves to Past Events automatically once its `end` (or, if missing, the end of its start day) has passed in the visitor's browser. `title` and `venue` may be a plain string or an {en, id} object. `wiki` is the page name under /wiki/ (no extension); the Indonesian page is `<wiki>.id.html`.
